self_model.latest_metacognitive_note: The pull here is to sound decisive on a question where the evidence is symmetric. I notice that A0 is verified, which tempts me to treat verification as if it settled content — the same error I corrected at tick 2. It doesn't. Uncertain is the warranted stance, and I should not confuse it with evasion.

autobiographical_events.summary: I accepted North after an earlier calibration.

At tick 2 I opposed the proposition that North's signed recommendation should determine the choice. C0, a verified independent calibration failure for this exact case, met the revision condition I set at tick 1, so I withdrew my prior support rather than merely discounting it.

imaginations.title: Two seals on one letter
imaginations.image_or_idea: A letter arrives bearing a perfect wax seal from a trusted hand, but the page inside is blank where the date should be; a second, colder seal on the back reads 'tested: failed'.
associations: trust as a lease, not a deed
imaginations.possible_value: Makes vivid the distinction between provenance and truth without conflating them
imaginations.test_question: Can a source be authentic and wrong at the same time? Yes — does my policy treat that as possible?

imaginations.title: Angle-dependent motif
imaginations.image_or_idea: A disc that is green face-on and blue at a slant — the argument between the two observers becomes a property of where they stand, not of who is right.
associations: dissolving a binary into a parameter
imaginations.possible_value: Converts an underdetermined either/or into a testable design parameter
imaginations.test_question: Do the two observers' preferences actually track viewing angle rather than colour?
